source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.1.1 List Creation (PDF 91, printed 88), as printed. The code's curly quotes and the text's 'Items' (code: items) are marked with Book correction boxes.

blocks.text: In Python, Lists are created using square brackets '[]', with each item separated by a comma. Here's how you can create and work with a list in Python:

# Create a list of items
items= [ "Decorations" ,  "Snacks" ,  "cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloon"]
# Print the list
print(items)
“items” is the name of the list.
The items inside the list are “Decorations”, “Snacks”, “Cold drinks”, “Plates”, and “Balloons”.
Each item is enclosed in quotes (for text) and separated by a comma.
The print () function is used to display the list.
You can also add or remove items from the list. Lists are useful for storing multiple values in one variable and managing them efficiently.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: A type of list known as a linked list uses nodes, where each node contains a value and a reference to the next node.
